sourceRefs.locator: Results, Archaeology and extinctions, pp. 4–5, and Fig. 2C, F, H: biface 12080-1, Unit 3c, and seven adjacent dates
Site setting and Fig. 1A: lower Aucilla River and sinkhole about 11.5 km inland from the modern Gulf. Rounded orientation

summary.de: Heute überfluteter Fundplatz am unteren Aucilla River. Die frühen Funde lagen an einem zeitweise zugänglichen Teichrand.
summary.en: A submerged site on the lower Aucilla River. The early finds lay on a periodically accessible pond margin.
